name: TILTING_TRUCK_HAIRPIN_BEND_YELLOW_TALL

sa_w1-sa50-6_truck_arrow.desc: tilting truck on a ground line above the hairpin arrow (W1-7)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W1-SA50-6 (L or R): W1-SA50-6A 1000 x 2000 illustrated (B 1500 x 3000), R150, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). Truck tilting at 30 degrees on a 45 thick ground line (TRUCK DETAILS: body 453 x 567, 770 wide x 885 high overall, 120 / 770 / 110 across) above the hairpin arrow (W1-7) drawn to the sheet's ARROW DETAILS. The whole black legend is taken as one symbol from the sheet's filled artwork (PDF fills at 1000 dpi, traced; ink box x 93-892, y 154-1846). The sheet draws the left-hand sign; (R) mirrors it.
